g.text: 4 · Training pipelines: how each model is made, and the gate it must pass
red-bordered box = gate (pass/fail) · dashed arrow = loop back on failure
A · Walking policy (GPU server → Pi Zero 2 W)
change for Jero: command switch every 1–3 s (was 10 s)
B · Intent model, ModernBERT (GPU server → RB3 Gen 2)
C · Speech in / out: pretrained, configured, not trained (RB3 Gen 2)
